categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in fashion product design, with main applications in footwear design and pattern design for consumer goods. The business is divided into three segments: design services (鞋履设计 and 图案设计), supply chain integration services, and footwear production. The company also explores new retail and business models including e-commerce operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs a streamlined design system featuring centralized trend research, modular design workflows, and standardized development processes. Core technologies include footwear last design, shoe sole design, material and color matching, and pattern design. The company has established research capabilities in functional footwear, smart temperature control systems, and flat foot correction shoes. Production methods include both outsourced manufacturing coordination and in-house production at facilities in Wenzhou and Xinjiang.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major footwear brands (both domestic and international), with significant exposure to European markets through clients like CCC (Polish footwear brand). The company serves mid-range and mass-market footwear brands, women's shoe manufacturers, children's shoe producers, and traditional footwear OEM/trading enterprises. Geographic markets span Europe, Asia, and domestic China, with 83.58% of 2023 revenue from overseas sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Wenzhou, Zhejiang Province. Key operating regions include Wenzhou (design and supply chain hub), Hangzhou (creative design center), Shanghai (brand management), Xinjiang (production base in Hetian), and Guangzhou (brand management). International presence is concentrated in European markets, particularly Central and Eastern Europe through major clients.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the supply chain: upstream in design and R&D, midstream in supply chain integration and quality control, and downstream in brand channel operations (emerging). The company coordinates with footwear manufacturers, material suppliers, and logistics providers while maintaining its own production facilities to ensure design implementation and quality control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) strengthening R&D design teams and expanding designer recruitment; (2) expanding pattern design applications across multiple product categories; (3) enhancing supply chain integration capabilities through standardization; (4) establishing a designer resource sharing platform in Hangzhou; (5) expanding market reach and customer base; (6) developing new retail channels including live-streaming bases and self-owned brands. R&D focuses on functional footwear, smart materials, and design-to-production efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through: (1) Design services - selling design solutions and sample shoes to footwear brands (93.62% gross margin); (2) Supply chain integration - coordinating manufacturing and selling finished products to customers (9.00% gross margin); (3) Footwear production - direct manufacturing at company facilities (4.08% gross margin); (4) Other services including pattern design applications and licensing. Revenue is recognized upon customer acceptance of designs or delivery of products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with: internal design departments of large footwear brands, small design studios and independent designers, and ODM enterprises with basic design capabilities. The company's competitive advantages include: scale-based design capability (nearly 10,000 designs annually), efficient modular design system, supply chain integration expertise, and first-mover advantage in professional footwear design services. The company is positioned as a leading third-party professional footwear design enterprise with rare scale-based design capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: 2023 revenue was RMB 490.5 million (down 14.24% YoY), with net profit of RMB 21.3 million (down 71.05% YoY). Total assets reached RMB 1.29 billion. The company is in a growth phase but faced headwinds in 2023 due to exchange rate fluctuations, new business startup losses, and customer structure optimization. The company maintains strong liquidity with RMB 361.4 million in cash and a 20.17% asset-liability ratio.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's unique value proposition centers on: (1) Scalable design capability - providing bulk, wholesale-style design services matching fast-fashion trends; (2) Design-to-production integration - ensuring design concepts are properly implemented through supply chain coordination; (3) Trend expertise - centralized research and modular design processes enabling rapid response to market trends; (4) Industry specialization - deep expertise in footwear design with understanding of manufacturing constraints; (5) Quality assurance - professional quality control and production supervision ensuring design integrity. The company differentiates through combining artistic design with industrial production feasibility.
